security_audit.summary: All 11 external-command alerts are false positives caused by Markdown fences or JavaScript template literals. Three examples perform outbound POST requests, including one that sends a Grafana bearer token to a configured endpoint. No prompt injection or malicious intent appears, but users should validate destinations and use least-privilege credentials.

remediation.issue: HTTP examples trust configured service URLs, and the Grafana request forwards a bearer token.
remediation.suggestion: Allowlist HTTPS hosts, keep tokens outside untrusted configuration, add timeouts, and check responses before using these examples.

remediation.issue: The CI example references actions/checkout with a mutable major-version tag.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the action to a reviewed full commit SHA and use automated dependency updates.

content.user_title: Monitor Database Migrations in Real Time
content.value_statement: Database migrations can fail without clear signals about lag, throughput, or errors. This skill designs CDC monitoring, metrics, dashboards, and alerts for migration workflows.
actual_capabilities: Provides MongoDB migration patterns with structured logs and Prometheus metrics.
Outlines Debezium and Kafka monitoring for CDC events and replication lag.
Defines migration metrics for duration, row counts, lag, throughput, and errors.
Creates Grafana dashboard concepts and automated dashboard provisioning patterns.
Shows anomaly alerts and CI health checks for migration workflows.
limitations: The skill provides guidance and examples, not deployed monitoring infrastructure.
Examples contain placeholders and require adaptation for each database, network, and authentication model.
The skill does not validate configured endpoints, credentials, schemas, or migration data.
The guidance does not replace load testing, rollback planning, or production review.

use_cases.title: Instrument a Live Migration
use_cases.description: Add logs, progress metrics, lag measurements, and error counters to an active database migration.

use_cases.title: Monitor a CDC Pipeline
use_cases.description: Design Debezium and Kafka visibility for event throughput, consumer lag, and source-to-target delay.

use_cases.title: Build Migration Alerts
use_cases.description: Define dashboards, thresholds, notifications, and CI health gates for production migration operations.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Basic Migration Metrics
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend essential metrics for a [database type] migration. Include progress, duration, lag, throughput, failures, and practical alert thresholds.
prompt_templates.scenario: Starting observability for a simple migration

prompt_templates.title: Design CDC Monitoring
prompt_templates.prompt: Design monitoring for a Debezium pipeline from [source] to [target] through Kafka. Cover connector health, lag, throughput, errors, and recovery signals.
prompt_templates.scenario: Operating a change data capture pipeline

prompt_templates.title: Plan Dashboards and Alerts
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Grafana dashboard and alert plan for [migration]. Use Prometheus metrics and separate warning, critical, and recovery conditions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Preparing an operations view and notifications

prompt_templates.title: Architect Production Observability
prompt_templates.prompt: Design end-to-end observability for [migration architecture]. Include metric definitions, label controls, CDC validation, anomaly detection, dashboards, alerts, CI gates, and rollback signals.

output_examples.input: Recommend monitoring for a PostgreSQL CDC migration.
output: Track connector state, source log position, consumer lag, event throughput, and failed records.
Alert when replication lag exceeds 60 seconds for five minutes or connector failures persist.
Dashboard migration progress, per-table throughput, lag percentiles, and recovery status.

output_examples.input: Plan alerts for a MongoDB migration.
output: Warn when throughput falls below half of the expected rate.
Escalate when errors exceed one percent or progress remains unchanged.
Resolve alerts only after throughput and error rates remain healthy.

output_examples.input: Add migration checks to continuous integration.
output_examples.output: Start monitoring before the migration, run the migration, then fail the workflow when lag or error thresholds remain unhealthy.

best_practices: Define baseline throughput and lag before choosing alert thresholds.
Use bounded labels to prevent excessive Prometheus metric cardinality.
Test dashboards, alerts, credentials, and rollback signals in a staging environment.
anti_patterns: Do not expose database credentials, API tokens, or webhook URLs in logs and metrics.
Do not treat event counts alone as proof that source and target data match.
Do not deploy untested alert thresholds that can hide failures or create alert noise.

faq.question: Which databases does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It includes MongoDB and PostgreSQL examples, with patterns that can be adapted to other migration systems.

faq.question: Does the skill deploy Prometheus or Grafana?
faq.answer: No. It provides instrumentation, dashboard, and provisioning patterns that require environment-specific implementation.

faq.question: Can it monitor Debezium and Kafka?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers connector setup, event processing, consumer lag, throughput, and replication lag concepts.

faq.question: Does it verify source and target data?
faq.answer: No. Add independent reconciliation checks for row counts, checksums, schemas, and critical business records.

faq.question: How should secrets be handled?
faq.answer: Store secrets in an approved secret manager, restrict their scope, validate destinations, and prevent values from entering logs.

faq.question: Is the generated guidance production ready?
faq.answer: No. Review dependencies, security, capacity, failure handling, thresholds, and rollback behavior before production use.
